name: Russian Ground Forces
tagline: The god of war is artillery.
desc: Doctrine built on massed fires: cheap self-propelled artillery and rocket launchers, tough vehicles with reactive armor and thick layered air defense. Premium air and naval assets are few, and sortie rates are low.

missile_doctrine.name: Missile & Artillery
missile_doctrine.desc: Rockets and guns win wars. Cheap strikes; starts with rocket artillery.

layered_ad.name: Layered Air Defense
layered_ad.desc: S-400 umbrella. Starts with SAMs, CIWS and interceptors.

armored_wedge.name: Armored Wedge
armored_wedge.desc: Cheaper, tougher armor. Starts with a tank spearhead.

rifleman.name: AK-12 Motor Rifleman
rifleman.desc: 5.45 mm rifle with a modernised AK action; simple, rugged and cheap to field. Motor rifle troops ride in vehicles.

assault.name: AKS-74U Carbine Trooper
assault.desc: Short AK-74 variant for vehicle crews and urban fighting; lots of muzzle flash and little accuracy.

bazooka.name: RPG-7VR Trooper
bazooka.desc: Reloadable launcher with a tandem 105 mm warhead; cheap, simple and used everywhere.

manpads.name: Igla-S AA Team
manpads.desc: Infrared-homing missile with 6 km reach and a proximity fuse; widely exported.

mg_gunner.name: PKM Machine Gunner
mg_gunner.desc: 7.62x54R belt-fed machine gun, very rugged; the platoon's base of fire.

grenadier.name: GP-34 Grenadier
grenadier.desc: Under-barrel 40 mm grenade launcher on an AK; 400 m.

sniper.name: SV-98 Sniper
sniper.desc: 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle with 1,000 m effective range; accurate and cheap.

flamer.name: RPO-A Shmel Gunner
flamer.desc: 93 mm disposable launcher with a thermobaric warhead equal to a 152 mm HE shell; devastating in buildings and bunkers.

medic.name: Combat Medic
medic.desc: Battalion medic with a modern IFAK; Russian casualty care has improved but is still behind NATO.

engineer.name: Sapper Engineer
engineer.desc: Engineer troops clear mines, build obstacles and demolish bridges. Russian engineers are numerous.

commando.name: Spetsnaz GRU Operator
commando.desc: GRU Spetsnaz with suppressed AS Val or AK-12K, night vision and body armor; highly trained but few.

jeep.name: GAZ Tigr
jeep.desc: Armored 4x4 with a 7.62 mm PKT mount; fast and mine-resistant.

armored_car.name: BRDM-2
armored_car.desc: Four-wheel amphibious scout car with a 14.5 mm KPVT; used since 1962.

apc.name: BTR-82A
apc.desc: 8x8 armored personnel carrier with a 30 mm 2A72 cannon and 7 dismounts.

light_tank.name: 2S25 Sprut-SD
light_tank.desc: Air-droppable 125 mm self-propelled gun, weighing 18 t; fast but lightly armored.

tank.name: T-72B3M
tank.desc: Upgraded T-72 with Relikt ERA, 125 mm gun and an improved sight; the workhorse of the Russian tank force.

heavy_tank.name: T-90M Proryv
heavy_tank.desc: Russia's best tank in service: Relikt ERA, Kaktus ERA, a new turret and a 125 mm gun.

mammoth.name: T-14 Armata
mammoth.desc: Unmanned turret, armored capsule for the crew and Afghanit APS; very few built and in limited service.

tank_destroyer.name: 9P149 Shturm-S
tank_destroyer.desc: MT-LB chassis with 9M120 Ataka missiles (6 km); radio-guided.

flame_tank.name: TOS-1A Solntsepyok
flame_tank.desc: T-72 chassis with 24 x 220 mm thermobaric rockets; ranges up to 6 km. Destroys everything in a hectare.

artillery.name: 2S19 Msta-S
artillery.desc: 152 mm turret on a T-80 chassis; ~8 rounds per min and 25 km range; Russia's standard SPG.

howitzer.name: 2S35 Koalitsiya-SV
howitzer.desc: Unmanned 152 mm turret with autoloader and a 70 km range with rocket-assisted projectiles; few built.

mlrs.name: BM-30 Smerch
mlrs.desc: 12 x 300 mm rockets, 20-90 km, huge saturation; seen as a high value.

aa_truck.name: Pantsir-S1
aa_truck.desc: Twin 30 mm cannons plus 12 missiles on a truck; a fast short-range air defense with its own radar.

sam_truck.name: S-400 Triumf TEL
sam_truck.desc: Four-missile TEL with 40N6 missiles up to 400 km; the main medium/long-range SAM.

repair_vehicle.name: BREM-1 ARV
repair_vehicle.desc: T-72 chassis with crane and winch; can tow a tank across a river.

drone.name: Lancet-3 Loitering Munition
drone.desc: ZALA Lancet-3 with a 3 kg warhead; 40 km range and 40 minutes endurance. Widely used against artillery and armor.

fighter.name: Su-35S Flanker-E
fighter.desc: Thrust-vectoring heavy fighter with the Irbis-E radar; very agile but not stealthy.

interceptor_jet.name: MiG-31BM Foxhound
interceptor_jet.desc: Mach 2.8 interceptor with a huge radar and R-33 missiles of 120 km range.

stealth_fighter.name: Su-57 Felon
stealth_fighter.desc: 5th-gen fighter with partial stealth and supercruise; very few in service.

strike_jet.name: Su-34 Fullback
strike_jet.desc: Side-by-side crew, heavy armor and a long range for deep strike; 12 t of weapons.

helicopter.name: Ka-52 Alligator
helicopter.desc: Coaxial rotor attack helicopter with ejection seats; Vikhr ATGMs and a 30 mm gun.

gunship.name: Mi-28NM Night Hunter
gunship.desc: Armored attack helicopter with tandem seating and a 30 mm cannon; new NM variant has radar.

light_bomber.name: Su-25SM3 Frogfoot
light_bomber.desc: Armored subsonic attack jet; survives hits that would down other aircraft, with a 30 mm gun and 4 t of bombs.

bomber.name: Tu-22M3 Backfire
bomber.desc: Variable-sweep bomber with Mach 1.8 dash and 24 t of ordnance; carries Kh-22 and Kh-32 missiles.

heavy_bomber.name: Tu-160M White Swan
heavy_bomber.desc: Largest supersonic bomber ever built, 45 t payload including Kh-101 cruise missiles.

stealth_bomber.name: PAK DA Stealth Bomber
stealth_bomber.desc: Flying-wing subsonic stealth bomber, in development; first flight not yet confirmed.

diver.name: Naval Spetsnaz Swimmer
diver.desc: Navy combat swimmers with APS underwater rifles and limpet mines.

patrol_boat.name: Raptor Patrol Boat
patrol_boat.desc: Project 03160 high-speed boat with a 14.5 mm MG; troop carrier and patrol.

gunboat.name: Grachonok Anti-Sabotage Boat
gunboat.desc: Project 21980 with 14.5 mm and 30 mm guns plus a grenade launcher; protects ports from divers.

missile_boat.name: Buyan-M Corvette
missile_boat.desc: 950 t corvette with eight Kalibr cells and a 100 mm gun; a river-capable launch platform.

destroyer.name: Admiral Gorshkov (Project 22350)
destroyer.desc: 4,500 t frigate with 32 VLS cells (Kalibr/Oniks/Redut) and a 130 mm gun.

cruiser.name: Slava-class Cruiser
cruiser.desc: 11,500 t with 16 P-1000 Vulkan anti-ship missiles and S-300F SAMs.

battleship.name: Kirov-class Battlecruiser
battleship.desc: 24,000 t nuclear cruiser (Pyotr Velikiy) with 20 Granit missiles; the world's largest non-carrier surface warship.

submarine.name: Yasen-M Submarine
submarine.desc: Nuclear multi-purpose sub with 32 VLS cells for Kalibr/Oniks and heavy torpedoes.

aircraft_carrier.name: Admiral Kuznetsov
aircraft_carrier.desc: Russia's only carrier: ski-jump deck, Su-33 and MiG-29K aircraft; prone to breakdowns and fires.

mg_turret.name: Kord 12.7 mm HMG Position
mg_turret.desc: 12.7x108 mm Kord on a tripod in a prepared position.

pillbox.name: Reinforced Firing Point
pillbox.desc: Concrete and earth reinforced firing point with overhead cover.

at_gun.name: 9K111 Fagot Post
at_gun.desc: Wire-guided 9M111 missile, 2 km range; a simple, old design still in use.

cannon_turret.name: Dug-In T-72 Turret
cannon_turret.desc: T-72 turret in a buried position with a 125 mm gun; a common stopgap.

mortar_pit.name: 2B11 Sani 120 mm Mortar
mortar_pit.desc: 120 mm mortar with 7 km range and 15 rounds per minute.

flak_battery.name: ZU-23-2 AA Gun
flak_battery.desc: Twin 23 mm anti-aircraft gun, much used on trucks in the Ukraine war.

sam_site.name: Tor-M2 SAM Site
sam_site.desc: All-weather SAM with a 15 km range and a phased-array radar; very effective vs cruise missiles and drones.

heavy_battery.name: 2A36 Giatsint-B Battery
heavy_battery.desc: 152 mm towed gun with 30 km range; very long and flat trajectories.

railgun.name: Peresvet Laser Complex
railgun.desc: Mobile combat laser system, in service since 2018; intended to blind optics and destroy drones.

ciws.name: Pantsir-SM CIWS
ciws.desc: Gun-missile CIWS with radar, EO tracking and 30 mm guns.

interceptor_battery.name: S-400 Triumf Battery
interceptor_battery.desc: Layered AD with multiple missiles (400 km); the core of Russian IADS.

abm_battery.name: S-500 Prometey
abm_battery.desc: New S-500 with 77N6 interceptors designed to hit ICBM warheads and hypersonic weapons.

repair_depot.name: Mobile Repair Base
repair_depot.desc: Mobile workshop (PRM) for armored vehicle repair.

coastal_battery.name: Bastion-P Coastal Battery
coastal_battery.desc: Coastal defense with P-800 Oniks missiles; range up to 350 km.

tactical_missile.name: 9K79 Tochka-U
tactical_missile.desc: Short-range ballistic missile, 120 km range with a 482 kg warhead.

cruise_missile.name: 3M14 Kalibr
cruise_missile.desc: Subsonic missile with 450 kg warhead, 2,500 km range from ships and subs.

cluster_missile.name: 9M55K Smerch Cluster
cluster_missile.desc: 300 mm rocket carrying 72 submunitions; 90 km range.

bunker_buster.name: KAB-1500 Guided Bomb
bunker_buster.desc: 1,500 kg satellite- or laser-guided bomb with a concrete-piercing warhead.

ballistic_missile.name: 9M723 Iskander-M
ballistic_missile.desc: SRBM with maneuvering warhead and decoys; 500 km, 480 kg.

hypersonic.name: Kh-47M2 Kinzhal
hypersonic.desc: Mach 10 air-launched ballistic missile from MiG-31K; 2,000 km claimed.

tactical_nuke.name: 9M723 Nuclear Warhead
tactical_nuke.desc: Iskander-M with a nuclear warhead of 5-50 kt.

nuke.name: RS-24 Yars ICBM
nuke.desc: Mobile ICBM with up to four MIRVs of 150-300 kt; 11,000 km.

mega_nuke.name: RS-28 Sarmat ICBM
mega_nuke.desc: 208-t liquid-fueled heavy ICBM with multiple warheads (up to 10+); 18,000 km. Flight tests are still under way.
